g.text: JOB-02 - daily00:30 fixed source set and late adjustments (REVIEW)
claim original day / missing backlog day
get or durably record FIRST cutoff before source work
original cutoff, unchanged on all retries
one consistent selection for recordedAt local day
persist fixed source members / immutable amounts
persist snapshot identity / SNAPSHOTTED with members
claim each source globally once as BASE
committed old-day source discovered after finalization
unique source => ADJUSTMENT in later period
include once in later period, never mutate finalized original
export immutable finalized version if requested
recordedAt can precede physical commit/midnight crossing.
A source contributes BASE OR ADJUSTMENT, never both.
Retry after snapshot commit preserves source set even if aggregation failed.
Failure before source freeze still preserves the original durable cutoff.
Missing days recovered in order; no client-supplied backdating.
